+# Service authentication and execution boundary
+
+The sequence below describes the ILCE-7CM2 2.01 observations. The authentication framing follows [Sony-PMCA-RE's Senser implementation](https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/blob/master/pmca/usb/sony.py); the two-mode sequence is also visible in its [USB service command](https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/blob/master/pmca/commands/usb.py).
+
+## USB session and authentication
+
+The host claims interface 0 with bulk IN and OUT endpoints. It first talks to the Mass Storage identity `054C:0E8A`. After the first authentication, the camera reconnects as `054C:0336`; the host opens that new device and authenticates again. The service requests are sent only after the second authentication.
+
+| Phase | Exchange | Meaning |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Start | Vendor control OUT: `bmRequestType=0x43`, request `1`, value `0x37FF`, index `0xD7AA` | Begin Senser. On this camera the control status may stall while authentication remains available. |
+| Challenge, repeated three times | Host sends logical command `1`; camera returns result `2` or `8` with challenge data | Result `2` selects the camera-compatible SHA-1 branch; `8` selects SHA-256. |
+| Proof, once per challenge | Host sends logical command `3`, a one-byte marker `1`, and the calculated digest; camera returns result `4` | Confirms that round. |
+| Completion | Host sends logical command `5`; camera returns result `6` and success byte `1` | Completes this device identity's authentication. |
+| Stop | Vendor control OUT: `bmRequestType=0x43`, request `1`, value `0xC800`, index `0x2855` | Ends the Senser session and initiates return to normal USB mode. |
+
+Each authentication message has a 516-byte big-endian frame: a 16-bit complemented command, a 16-bit salt, and 512 data bytes. The reply result is decoded as `((~cmd) & 0xFFFF) - salt`. The digest input depends on the currently enumerated device:
+
+- On `0E8A`, hash the first four challenge bytes.
+- On `0336`, hash the 512-byte challenge followed by the round's entry in the matching SHA-1 or SHA-256 [key table](https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/blob/master/pmca/usb/constants.py).
+- The result-`2` branch uses the SHA-1 length behavior implemented by Senser, rather than an interchangeable standard SHA-1 call. The compatibility function is in the linked [upstream implementation](https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/blob/master/pmca/usb/crypto.py).
+
+Successful completion on `0E8A` is followed by USB re-enumeration, so the `0336` exchange uses a fresh device handle and sequence state. A Start request or the new USB ID by itself is not evidence that authentication finished. After the second exchange, the host sends Senser packets with a 12-byte little-endian header (`size:32`, `pFunc:16`, `sequence:16`, then four 8-bit fields). The packet sequence starts at `1` and increments for each request. Function `0x10` reads ProductInfo; the investigated Jiritsu requests use function `0x40`. ProductInfo returned 88 bytes in the observed session.
+
+## How a file operation becomes code execution
+
+Jiritsu selects a file path before reading or writing it. In the investigated firmware, selectors containing `/tmp/jiritsu/../..` were resolved beyond the intended Jiritsu directory. The research used this path behavior to place a shared object in the temporary Work area and influence the loader's preload configuration. A later read through the same service file interface found the object path in `/etc/ld.so.preload`.
+
+The trigger was a Jiritsu DEBUG request. It started a root child running a fixed shell command. The child's dynamic loader consulted `/etc/ld.so.preload`, loaded the Work-area shared object, and ran its initialization function before the fixed command. The worker wrote a versioned result record and removed the preload entry. That record and a separate readback of the preload path establish execution and cleanup; an accepted USB request alone does not.
+
+The observed facts are the accepted path selectors, the `/etc/ld.so.preload` readback, the worker result, and the child context. The camera's internal mapping between the selected `/tmp` path and the observed `/etc` path has not been uniquely identified. The security boundary is clear: service-controlled file content became input to a privileged process's dynamic loader.

+# 服务认证交换与指令执行边界
+
+以下顺序对应 ILCE-7CM2 官方 2.01 的观察结果。认证帧结构可与 [Sony-PMCA-RE 的 Senser 实现](https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/blob/master/pmca/usb/sony.py)核对；其 [USB 服务入口](https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/blob/master/pmca/commands/usb.py)也展示了两次认证与中间的设备重新枚举。
+
+## USB 会话和认证
+
+主机占用接口 0 的 bulk IN/OUT 端点，先与海量存储身份 `054C:0E8A` 交互。第一次认证后，相机重新枚举为 `054C:0336`；主机打开这个新设备并再次认证，然后才使用服务指令。
+
+| 阶段 | 交换内容 | 作用 |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| 启动 | Vendor control OUT：`bmRequestType=0x43`、request `1`、value `0x37FF`、index `0xD7AA` | 启动 Senser。这台机身可能在控制传输状态阶段返回 stall，但仍继续提供认证。 |
+| 挑战，重复三轮 | 主机发送逻辑命令 `1`；相机返回结果 `2` 或 `8` 和挑战数据 | `2` 选择与机身兼容的 SHA-1 分支，`8` 选择 SHA-256。 |
+| 应答，每轮一次 | 主机发送逻辑命令 `3`、单字节标记 `1` 和算出的摘要；相机返回结果 `4` | 确认这一轮。 |
+| 完成 | 主机发送逻辑命令 `5`；相机返回结果 `6` 和成功字节 `1` | 完成当前 USB 身份的认证。 |
+| 结束 | Vendor control OUT：`bmRequestType=0x43`、request `1`、value `0xC800`、index `0x2855` | 结束 Senser 会话，启动返回普通 USB 模式的过程。 |
+
+每个认证消息是 516 字节的大端帧：16 位取反的命令、16 位 salt、512 字节数据。回复结果按 `((~cmd) & 0xFFFF) - salt` 还原。摘要输入取决于设备当前身份：
+
+- `0E8A`：取挑战数据的前四字节计算摘要。
+- `0336`：将 512 字节挑战数据接上该轮对应的 SHA-1 或 SHA-256 [密钥表项](https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/blob/master/pmca/usb/constants.py)，再计算摘要。
+- 结果为 `2` 时需要与 Senser 实现一致的 SHA-1 长度处理，不能直接换成普通 SHA-1 调用。[兼容函数](https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/blob/master/pmca/usb/crypto.py)见原始实现。
+
+`0E8A` 认证完成后设备会重新枚举，所以 `0336` 必须用新设备句柄和新的序列状态再次完成交换。仅看到 Start 请求或新的 USB ID，不能说明认证已成功。第二次认证后，主机发送带 12 字节小端头的 Senser 数据包：32 位负载长度、16 位功能号、16 位序列号、四个 8 位字段。序列号从 `1` 开始，每个请求递增。功能号 `0x10` 用于 ProductInfo，研究中的 Jiritsu 请求使用 `0x40`。所观察会话的 ProductInfo 返回 88 字节。
+
+## 文件操作如何变成指令执行
+
+Jiritsu 在读写文件前先选择路径。在研究的固件上，含有 `/tmp/jiritsu/../..` 的选择路径会解析到预期 Jiritsu 目录之外。研究利用这一行为在临时 Work 区域放置共享对象，并影响动态加载器的预加载配置；随后通过服务文件接口，从 `/etc/ld.so.preload` 回读到了写入的对象路径。
+
+触发点是一条 Jiritsu DEBUG 请求。它启动运行固定 shell 命令的 root 子进程。子进程的动态加载器读取 `/etc/ld.so.preload`，装入 Work 区域中的共享对象，并在固定命令前执行其初始化函数。工作对象写出带版本的结果记录并移除预加载条目。结果记录与预加载路径的单独回读共同证明执行和清理；仅有 USB 请求被接收并不足以证明代码已运行。
+

+# ILCE-7CM2 Service Mode Preload Research
+
+[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
+
+This repository traces the path from the ILCE-7CM2's USB service session to one-shot root code execution, observed on firmware 2.01. It maps the authentication exchange, Jiritsu path resolution, dynamic loader behavior and execution evidence.
+
+## Execution chain
+
+1. The camera starts as USB Mass Storage (`054C:0E8A`). The host opens interface 0, starts Senser, and completes a three-round challenge–response exchange.
+2. The camera re-enumerates as `054C:0336`. A fresh Senser exchange authenticates this service identity. [The protocol notes](PROTOCOL.md) give the control request, frame structure, digest inputs, replies, and two-mode sequence.
+3. Jiritsu file commands select paths containing `/tmp/jiritsu/../..`. On the investigated firmware, path resolution reaches outside the Jiritsu directory. A shared object is placed in temporary Work storage; after the preload-path write, a service read of `/etc/ld.so.preload` returns that object's path.
+4. A Jiritsu DEBUG request starts a root child for a fixed system command. Its dynamic loader reads `/etc/ld.so.preload`, loads the shared object, and runs the object's initialization function before the command.
+5. The worker writes a versioned result record and removes the preload entry. The host reads back both the record and the preload path, then verifies that USB returns to the normal identity.
+
+```mermaid
+flowchart LR
+    A[0E8A: MSC] --> B[Senser authentication]
+    B --> C[0336: service authentication]
+    C --> D[Jiritsu path resolution]
+    D --> E[Preload configuration]
+    E --> F[DEBUG root child]
+    F --> G[Shared-object initialization]
+```
+
+The trust-boundary failure is the combination of path resolution outside Jiritsu's intended directory and a privileged child consuming a service-controlled preload file. USB service access is the entry point; the loader is where file control becomes instruction execution. The result record provides stronger evidence than a successful USB transfer or mode switch alone.
+
+## What this enables
+
+The observed result is temporary code execution in the child process. It can be used to inspect internal state or access data allowed by that process. Firmware construction is a separate offline task. Installing a modified firmware image also needs an update acceptance path; preload execution does not permanently disable signature checks. The investigated update workflow restored its temporary gate afterward.
+
+The observations here are specific to ILCE-7CM2 firmware 2.01. Other versions require their own checks of the USB session, Jiritsu path behavior, loader, and child privileges. [Sony-PMCA-RE's Senser source](https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/blob/master/pmca/usb/sony.py) is the public reference for the authentication framing.

+# ILCE-7CM2 服务模式预加载机制研究
+
+[English](README.md)
+
+本仓库记录 ILCE-7CM2 官方 2.01 固件中，从 USB 服务会话到一次性 root 指令执行的路径。认证协议与执行链分开说明，便于核对每一步的作用。
+
+## 指令执行链
+
+1. 相机先以 USB 海量存储设备（`054C:0E8A`）出现。主机打开接口 0、启动 Senser，并完成三轮挑战—应答认证。
+2. 相机重新枚举为 `054C:0336`。主机对新的服务设备再次完成 Senser 认证。[协议说明](PROTOCOL.zh-CN.md)列出控制请求、认证帧、摘要输入、返回值及两次认证的顺序。
+3. Jiritsu 文件指令选择含 `/tmp/jiritsu/../..` 的路径。在研究的固件上，路径解析会越过预期的 Jiritsu 目录。共享对象被放入临时 Work 存储区；写入预加载配置后，服务接口从 `/etc/ld.so.preload` 回读到了该对象路径。
+4. Jiritsu DEBUG 请求为固定系统命令启动一个 root 子进程。其动态加载器读取 `/etc/ld.so.preload`，装入共享对象，并在固定命令运行前执行对象的初始化函数。
+5. 工作对象写出带版本的结果记录并删除预加载条目。主机分别回读结果和预加载路径，再确认 USB 回到普通设备身份。
+
+```mermaid
+flowchart LR
+    A[0E8A 海量存储] --> B[Senser 认证]
+    B --> C[0336 服务认证]
+    C --> D[Jiritsu 路径解析]
+    D --> E[预加载配置]
+    E --> F[DEBUG root 子进程]
+    F --> G[共享对象初始化代码]
+```
+
+信任边界在两处连续被跨越：路径解析离开 Jiritsu 预期目录，随后特权子进程读取了服务接口可控制的预加载文件。USB 服务访问是入口；动态加载器使文件控制变成指令执行。带版本的结果记录，比仅看到 USB 传输成功或模式切换更能证明执行发生。
+
+## 能做什么
+
+已观察到的是子进程内的临时代码执行。它可用于检查内部状态，或访问该进程权限允许的数据。固件制作是独立的离线任务；要安装修改后的固件，还需要更新接受路径。预加载执行不会永久关闭签名检查。已研究的更新流程在结束后恢复了临时门控。
+
+本文结论针对 ILCE-7CM2 官方 2.01。其它版本应分别检查 USB 会话、Jiritsu 路径、加载器和子进程权限。认证帧的公开参考实现见 [Sony-PMCA-RE Senser 源码](https://github.com/ma1co/Sony-PMCA-RE/blob/master/pmca/usb/sony.py)。
